title: Bound on entries below a sorted list element
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a linearly ordered type, and let $s$ be a finite list in $\alpha$ whose entries are in nondecreasing order. For any index $j$ with $j<|s|$, the number of entries of $s$ strictly less than its entry at index $j$ is at most $j$.
hypotheses_covered: the entries of $s$ are in nondecreasing order
